title: Lanterns and Broken Icons
description: A surreal dark composition shaped like a traditional robe or dress made of cracked black textured material. The form is adorned with glowing yellow rings, floating colorful lanterns, smoke, and scattered broken picture frames containing a grey alien, a white cat, red Chinese characters, and abstract symbols, all spilling into a colorful dot explosion at the base.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork of a traditional robe-shaped silhouette made from cracked black stone-like texture floating in darkness. The robe is covered in glowing golden rings and emits white smoke. Scattered broken picture frames show a grey alien, a white cartoon cat sticking out its tongue, red Chinese characters, and abstract symbols. Colorful paper lanterns float above while the bottom dissolves into an explosion of multicolored dots and fragments against a dark background.
